profile.resume_text:
# Jordan Petrenko (Synthetic Test Profile)
Location: Remote (EU / Ukraine timezone)
Target Role: Junior / Strong Junior Python Backend Developer

## Core Stack
- Python 3.12, AsyncIO, FastAPI, Pydantic v2
- PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy 2.0 (async), Alembic
- Docker, Docker Compose, Git, GitHub Actions (CI)
- Testing & Quality: pytest, ruff, mypy
- Experience: ~6 months commercial/freelance + 2 completed backend portfolio projects (REST APIs, OAuth2, async DB pipelines, LLM integration)

## Preferences
- Remote or hybrid
- Backend / API / AI-integration focused roles
- Not looking for: PHP, Java, 1C, Manual QA, Frontend-only, or Senior (4+ yrs) roles

calibration_examples.title: Senior PHP / Laravel Developer
calibration_examples.description_snippet: Looking for a Senior PHP developer with 5+ years of Laravel and Symfony experience to maintain a legacy billing monolith. Office-only.
calibration_examples.rationale: Wrong primary language (PHP instead of Python), Senior level (5+ years), and office-only legacy maintenance.

calibration_examples.title: Junior QA Engineer (with Python scripting)
calibration_examples.description_snippet: Manual regression testing of web apps (70%), writing basic Selenium test scripts in Python (30%). SQL basics are a plus.
calibration_examples.rationale: Mentions Python, so keyword filter may pass, but the role is primarily Manual QA rather than backend software engineering.

calibration_examples.title: Senior Python Backend Engineer (Distributed Systems)
calibration_examples.description_snippet: 5+ years Python, high-load Kafka pipelines, Kubernetes operators, gRPC microservices, mentoring junior developers. FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
calibration_examples.rationale: Matching core stack (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL), but 5+ years seniority and heavy distributed infrastructure expectations make it unrealistic.

calibration_examples.title: Junior/Middle Python Django Developer
calibration_examples.description_snippet: 1+ year with Django, DRF, Celery, PostgreSQL. Some legacy Django templates and jQuery maintenance. Remote friendly.
calibration_examples.rationale: Right language, remote format, and near-matching seniority, though focused on Django monolith + legacy frontend templates rather than FastAPI.

calibration_examples.title: Python Data Scraping & Automation Engineer
calibration_examples.description_snippet: Build Playwright/Scrapy crawlers, clean datasets with Pandas, expose a tiny internal FastAPI status endpoint. 1 year Python experience.
calibration_examples.rationale: Good Python level and mentions FastAPI, but day-to-day work is web scraping and ETL scripting rather than core backend product architecture.

calibration_examples.title: Middle- Python Backend Developer (FastAPI + Redis)
calibration_examples.description_snippet: 1.5-2 years commercial Python. FastAPI, SQLAlchemy async, PostgreSQL, Redis caching, Celery, Docker. Strong engineering culture.
calibration_examples.rationale: Almost exact stack match and great product fit, but asks for 1.5-2 years experience plus Redis/Celery production exposure — borderline stretch role worth watching.

calibration_examples.title: Junior+ Python Backend Developer (FastAPI / Postgres)
calibration_examples.description_snippet: 6+ months commercial or strong pet-project experience. FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0, PostgreSQL, Docker, pytest. Nice to have: Redis.
calibration_examples.rationale: Strong match on FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0, PostgreSQL, Docker, and testing expectations; only minor nice-to-have gap in Redis.

calibration_examples.title: Junior Python / AI Integration Backend Engineer
calibration_examples.description_snippet: Build async FastAPI services, PostgreSQL + Alembic migrations, structured LLM integrations (Gemini/OpenAI APIs), CI with ruff and pytest. Fully remote.
calibration_examples.rationale: Near-ideal match across core stack (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy/Alembic, Postgres, pytest, ruff) plus direct alignment with AI API integration experience.
